name: What are common signs of a gas leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a gas leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a gas leak include a distinct sulfur-like or rotten egg odor, often added to natural gas for detection. You might also hear a hissing sound near a gas line or appliance, see a damaged gas pipe or connection, or notice dead or discolored vegetation near outdoor gas lines. For your safety, if you suspect a gas leak, evacuate your property immediately and contact your gas utility company and CG Plumbing Solutions for an inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs of a gas leak include a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, or damaged gas lines. Evacuate and call your gas utility and a plumber if you suspect a leak.
